A confounds composition with “mixing entropy,” treats entropy as directly causing static lattice distortion, and proposes a poorly defined lower-entropy but compositionally similar baseline; B still requires verification that precipitates remain stable rather than dissolve or coarsen at 1000–1400 °C.
